slice: PAR-06/PAR-20 ACadSharp XDATA/repeated-record threat applicability audit
question: Does the local DXF path share a 16-bit aggregate-XDATA length or recursive repeated-record path, and is a new test needed?

localAudit.xdataStorage: Entity and table-entry XDATA values are retained as individual typed values in vectors; the local limit is DRW_TableEntry::kMaxExtendedDataItems (1,000,000), with per-read byte/node budgets also enforced.
localAudit.xdataWriter: validateDxfXdataGroups iterates the existing value range and the writer emits individual group-code records; the audited route has no 16-bit aggregate-XDATA byte-length field.
localAudit.recordTraversal: The DXF reader consumes group records through iterative read/dispatch loops. The repeated-record reports identify a peer failure shape, not a matching local recursive path.
localAudit.existingControl: tests/hardening_tests.cpp::testRepeatedDxfRecordRobustness generates 20,000 XDATA APPID/value pairs (40,000 values) in ASCII and Binary DXF and checks exact order plus a following LINE; it also checks 20,000 ASCII comments and repeated WIPEOUT records.

disposition.classification: NOT_APPLICABLE_LOCAL_PATH; existing generated stress control already covers large iterative XDATA and repeated-record handling
disposition.next: Self-unblock to the next source-backed local PAR-07/PAR-14 item; do not wait for unavailable peer samples or native qualification.
